# std.schema

<!-- Generated by `badger doc std` from the checked interfaces (badger 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Typed schemas and versioned wire contracts.

## Types

### `Wire`

```badger
struct Wire<T> { pub version: Int, names: Map<String, String>, aliases: Map<String, List<String>> }
```

A versioned wire contract for `T`. Wire names of fields and variants are
schema choices, independent of the language names and of memory layout:
a member is named `"Type.field"`, `"Type.variant"`, or
`"Type.variant.field"`. Older names stay decodable with `accept`.

#### `Wire.accept`

```badger
fn accept(self: &Self, member: String, old: String) -> Wire<T>
```

Also accept `old` for `member` when decoding (a name from an earlier
version); encoding always uses the current name.

#### `Wire.decode`

```badger
fn decode(self: &Self, bytes: Bytes) -> Result<T, codec.DecodeError>
```

#### `Wire.decode_text`

```badger
fn decode_text(self: &Self, text: String) -> Result<T, codec.DecodeError>
```

#### `Wire.describe`

```badger
fn describe(self: &Self) -> String
```

The schema description under this contract's wire names.

#### `Wire.encode`

```badger
fn encode(self: &Self, value: T) -> Bytes
```

#### `Wire.encode_text`

```badger
fn encode_text(self: &Self, value: T) -> String
```

#### `Wire.json_schema`

```badger
fn json_schema(self: &Self) -> String
```

The JSON Schema under this contract's wire names.

#### `Wire.rename`

```badger
fn rename(self: &Self, member: String, name: String) -> Wire<T>
```

Encode `member` as `name` on the wire.

## Functions

### `decode`

```badger
fn decode<T>(s: Schema<T>, bytes: Bytes) -> Result<T, codec.DecodeError> where T: Codec
```

Validate and decode external input; errors carry the input path.

### `decode_text`

```badger
fn decode_text<T>(s: Schema<T>, text: String) -> Result<T, codec.DecodeError> where T: Codec
```

### `describe`

```badger
fn describe<T>(s: Schema<T>) -> String
```

A JSON description of a schema (fields, variants, element types).

### `encode`

```badger
fn encode<T>(s: Schema<T>, value: T) -> Bytes where T: Codec
```

### `fields`

```badger
fn fields<T>(value: T) -> List<(String, Data)> where T: Codec
```

The fields of a record or struct value as `(wire name, Data)` pairs.

### `from_data`

```badger
fn from_data<T>(s: Schema<T>, data: Data) -> Result<T, codec.DecodeError> where T: Codec
```

### `json_schema`

```badger
fn json_schema<T>(s: Schema<T>) -> String
```

The JSON Schema of `T`'s wire form (for OpenAPI and other tools).

### `of`

```badger
fn of<T>() -> Schema<T> where T: Codec
```

The derived schema of `T`.

### `visit`

```badger
fn visit<T>(value: T, visitor: fn(String, Data) -> Unit) -> Unit where T: Codec
```

Typed reflection: visit each field of a record or struct value, in
canonical (label) order, with its wire name and its value as explicit
`Data`.
(Heterogeneous fields become homogeneous only through this visitor.)

### `wire`

```badger
fn wire<T>(s: Schema<T>, version: Int) -> Wire<T> where T: Codec
```

Version `version` of the wire contract for schema `s`, initially using
the language names.
